summary: Synchrony Financial filed an 8-K reporting an underwritten public offering of $1.1 billion aggregate principal amount of senior notes: $600 million of 5.450% Fixed-to-Floating Rate Senior Notes due 2030 and $500 million of 6.276% Fixed-to-Floating Rate Senior Notes due 2037. The offering was made under an existing Form S-3 shelf registration statement with J.P. Morgan, TD Securities, and Wells Fargo as underwriters. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, and the filing is an ordinary current report under Item 8.01. No special-situation characteristics apply.
